svg.title: Tiling ladder — FFN expansion — window_block_c128_fp16
svg.desc: Kernel-specific logical, CTA, warp and instruction tiles. A is purple, B yellow, D green; orange follows one contribution. FP8 instruction K=4 corresponds to native model channel 2. CTA K denotes one split; loop iterations visit its instruction panels.
svg.text: Focus axes: M = tokens; N = channels; K = 128 reduction values. B is concatenated branch Wexpand.
Each level is rescaled. Macro grids show subtiles; the lower zoom resolves individual scalars. Warp-grid cells are M16×N8 instructions.
Independent instruction microscope: panel-relative row 3, model K offset 2, output / key offset 2
• 4 warps per 8×8 window; origin selects shifted phase.
• Warp h owns branch h and then attention head h.
• C256 retains four query tiles; C64/C128 exchange attended panels in two-tile batches.
